name: InspirationTracker
description:
# InspirationTracker

Keeps D&D 5e Inspiration on the character sheet, the token and the chat in step. Works with the **D&D Fifth Edition (5E & 5.5E, 2024)** sheet, where it is called Heroic Inspiration, and the **D&D 5E by Roll20 (2014 OGL)** sheet.

* Give, remove or spend inspiration from a chat menu, the Command Deck handout, the sheet itself or the token marker.
* Every token for the character shows the marker you choose, including markers from custom marker sets.
* Players spend it with a Spend button or the Inspiration token action; the GM is told, with an Undo button.
* Party overview of who has it.
* 2024 rules: a character who would gain Heroic Inspiration while having it can give it to another party member.
* Optional special effect when inspiration is gained.
* Menus, messages and handouts in 24 languages.

Type `!inspiration` for the menu, or open the **InspirationTracker - Command Deck** handout. Full instructions are in the **InspirationTracker - Help** handout.

Upgrading from 0.1.x keeps your marker and special effect, and your own command name if you chose one.
